title: Awesome System One Models: A Curated, Evidence-Graded List of Typed Probabilistic Decision Models
description: A curated and evidence-graded list of System One models (typed probabilistic decision models), maintained alongside the survey System One Decision Models: A Survey of the Typed Decision Contract, Its Ecosystem and Its Evidence (Rafe and Das, manuscript under review). It reflects the survey cutoff of 28 October 2026.
